newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via multi-day system RP's.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via multi-day system RP's.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to add reserves to the banking system Thursday via multi-day fixed system repurchase agreements, analysts said.
Economists forecast the Fed's move would come either as four-day or seven-day fixed system RP's.
"It can go either way," said Patricia Thrapp, vice president at Aubrey G. Lanston. "Monday is a large tax date and the Fed will want to put reserves in the system through Monday," she added.
The Fed's daily add need is perceived to be approximately $5 billion for the first half of the current two-week reserve maintenance period, analysts said.
At 1045 EDT/1445 GMT, the federal funds rate was quoted at 5-3/16 percent, below the central bank's 5-1/4 percent target.
